calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, min(calendar_date) s, max(calendar_date) e, min(fiscal_week) w1, max(fiscal_week) w2 FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period IN (4,5) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory, s.store_id=900 AS web, s.store_id=999 AS s999,
  count(*) lines, count(distinct r.return_line_id) dist_lines, sum(r.quantity_returned) units,
  min(r.quantity_returned) minq, max(r.quantity_returned) maxq, sum(r.refund_net) refund
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
  AND (cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' OR p.subcategory='Garden Furniture')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

calls.statement:
WITH gr AS (
 SELECT r.*, f.quantity sold_qty, f.sale_date, f.net_amount sold_net
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND p.subcategory='Garden Furniture')
SELECT count(*) n, count(distinct sales_line_id) dsl, sum(CASE WHEN sold_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nosale,
 sum(CASE WHEN return_date<sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 sum(CASE WHEN return_date-sale_date>30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over30,
 sum(CASE WHEN quantity_returned>sold_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) overqty,
 sum(CASE WHEN refund_net<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM gr

SELECT d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, count(*) lines, sum(quantity_returned) units, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN quantity_returned ELSE 0 END) web_units
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT * FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, 'Garden Furniture' AS subcategory, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id <> 999
